titulo_ja: もし と アドバイス (2)

あきます.consejo: It is intransitive: the door opens itself.

texto: With a dictionary-shaped verb + **と**, you have a result that happens normally or automatically: **ボタン を おす と、 ドア が あきます** (when you press the button, the door opens). It is also used to give indications: **みぎ に まがる と、 えき が あります**.
In this use, it avoids an order or a request in the second part.
With **と** you don't ask for anything: don't say «**〜と ください**». **〜て ください** is used to order.
To say that something happens every year: **はる に なる と、 さくら が さきます** (in spring, cherry blossoms).

intro: The particle also serves to say that something happens **siempre** that is otherwise fulfilled. It is very useful to indicate ways and to explain how things work.
